# Poland

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Polish Bank Association (ZBP), ISO20022 group under Payment Services and SEPA Committee

**Role:** National banking-community recommendation publisher

**Reporting coverage:** Detailed national account-statement recommendation

**Messages / versions:** camt.053.001.08

- [KUPiS-GISO20022 working-group documentation](https://www.zbp.pl/Dla-Bankow/Bankowosc-elektroniczna/KUPiS-GISO20022) — availability; public-page
- [Recommendation: camt05300108 statement on Polish market](https://www.zbp.pl/getContentAsset/9f161734-17c7-402d-a56b-c285e7e7e7d6/1b52933d-ceff-4d97-bee2-094d491a3634/rekomendacja_standardu_4.pdf?language=pl) — specification; public-file

25page public national statement recommendation includes balances, pagination, parties, transactioncode tables. No camt052/054 coverage inferred from this053 guide. KIR payment clearing and NBP SORBNET documentation should be treated separately; SORBNET3 portal requires login.
